tool.title: Write the site sidebar's harness navbar include
tool.description: Render `_includes/generated/navbar-footer.html` from `docs/_data/harness.json` with the same renderer every railed page uses. With `--instance`, render the navbar of an IG repository's OWN site instead — that instance first, then what it needs; its own pages at this site's root, every other link to the main site at `--link-root` — into the shell that site is built from.

inputs.name: check
inputs.description: Fail if the committed include is stale; write nothing.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance whose own site this navbar is for.

inputs.name: link-root
inputs.description: With `--instance`: the main site's URL, for every link that is not this instance's own.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: With `--instance`: the label the navbar's home row carries.

inputs.name: out
inputs.description: With `--instance`: where to write the include (the shell's `_includes/generated/navbar-footer.html`).

outputs.name: include
outputs.description: The include written, or `up to date`.
